grid.fine: After coarse lock: alpha +/- .01 step .001, action/object +/- .01 step .001, gate kept on measured 5-unit grid.

fixed: Six model hashes, preprocessing, person ROI, tracker, 32-frame sampling, soft fallback, one compatible object in one of five same-person crops; no smoothing/training/new rule.

selection.inputs: Old onsite val + online val + binary user feedback on new9. Train and historical test diagnostic only.
selection.protection: Each supported old-val named-class TP >= baseline; old-val other FP, online-val FP, new known drink FP and unreviewed drink triggers no worse than baseline. Preserve the true new drink at action stage (object stage may reject).
selection.objective: Minimize 0.5*(old-val other FP/162 + new known drink FP/526); ties maximize old-val supported macro F1, old-val correct positives, new true drink; then normalized distance to original four settings.
selection.alternatives: Also retain best feasible true-drink option and best fixed-action .85 option.
selection.caveat: New9 are feedback calibration, old historical test repeatedly inspected; no untouched generalization set.

inference: Decode/enhance affected old sources, independent production trackers per gate, reuse detector/ungated pose by identical model hashes. Reuse RGB only for exact crop SHA; rerun gate-specific ST-GCN. Audit every raw new frame before reusing all new action caches across gates. Object scores >=.001 completed for union of reachable drink/pickup candidates.
coverage: All544 sources stay in inventory. Missing tracks/windows not correct; unmatched windows unknown. New binary not_drink never treated as multiclass other.
